thread:
maya: Heads up — nightly docs CI failing on the runtime samples job. One curl example 404s, it points to /docs/runtimes/client.md which no longer exists.

alex: Yup, saw it in CI: `docs-preflight (docs-sanity)` failed on samples check. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/12345

maya: snippet from the log: `HTTP 404 GET /docs/runtimes/client.md - 404 Not Found`

jordan: I think that file was moved in the restructure last year — current path is `/docs/runtime/client-examples.md`.

maya: can someone own a quick fix? It's causing the nightly site build to fail and blocking a small release.

sam: I can do a tiny PR. Plan: replace the broken link and add a short frontmatter redirect/owner. Quick sed I ran locally that worked: 
```
sed -i \"s|/docs/runtimes/client.md|/docs/runtime/client-examples.md|g\" site/content/runtime/*.md
```
I'll open a PR with the swap + frontmatter owner.

alex: Please also add `owners: docs-runtime` to the frontmatter so we get an owner ping next time. And add a one-line changelog entry.

sam: Will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1286 — includes link swap, frontmatter owner, and changelog note. CI queued.

docs-bot: PR #1286 opened by sam — docs-preflight build queued (job #789).

maya: thanks @sam :thumbsup: mark as a small patch and ping the release channel once green so we can unblock.

sam: done — added `#docs: runtime samples` to PR description and pinged #release.

jordan: LGTM once CI passes.

alex: assigning merge to @sam after green.

sam: will merge on green and self-assign the follow-up owner task in the docs tracker.
